title: ACA Open Enrollment 2027: Dates, Deadlines and Tips
description: HealthCare.gov open enrollment for 2027 coverage starts November 1, 2026. Deadlines, state exchange dates, rising premiums and how to compare Marketplace plans.
h1: ACA Marketplace open enrollment for 2027: dates and tips
intro: If you buy your own health insurance, open enrollment for 2027 Marketplace coverage starts on November 1, 2026. With premiums rising and subsidies smaller for many households, it is worth shopping carefully this year.

image.alt: Doctor writing notes on a patient chart

cardText: HealthCare.gov open enrollment for 2027 coverage starts November 1, 2026.

sections.html:
• November 1, 2026: open enrollment starts on HealthCare.gov.
  • December 15, 2026: enroll by this date for coverage starting January 1, 2027.
  • January 15, 2027: the HealthCare.gov window is expected to close; enrollments after December 15 generally start February 1.

States that run their own exchanges can set different dates, and some open earlier or close later. Rules on the length of the window have been subject to litigation, so confirm the current deadline on HealthCare.gov or your state exchange.

sections.h2: Why to compare plans this year
sections.html: Insurers have filed for further premium increases for 2027, and the enhanced premium tax credits that lowered costs from 2021 to 2025 have expired. See what changed with ACA subsidies. Do not auto-renew without checking your new premium, deductible and network.

• Update your expected 2027 income: subsidies are based on it.
  • Compare total yearly cost (premiums plus likely out-of-pocket costs), not just the premium.
  • Check your doctors, hospitals and prescriptions are covered.
  • Bronze and catastrophic Marketplace plans can now be paired with an HSA; see HSA changes.
  • Need adult dental? It is usually a separate plan; see our insurance guide.

General information, not medical, legal or insurance advice. This post reflects the position on the date shown. Check the official sources below for the latest rules.

faqs.q: When does ACA open enrollment start for 2027?
faqs.a: November 1, 2026 on HealthCare.gov. Enroll by December 15 for coverage starting January 1, 2027.
